Who I am

I'm Zayn Shah, a 7th-semester BS Computer Engineering student at International Islamic University, Islamabad. My degree is grounded in hardware: embedded systems, digital design and the physical constraints that every model eventually has to run within.

On top of that foundation I build applied AI. I have trained a face-mask classifier to 99.47% test accuracy with MobileNetV2, shipped a movie recommender with NLP sentiment analysis, designed Zyron, a multi-agent executive operating system, and built Zytech, a software-house product where an AI chatbot scopes and prices projects under strict server-side control. After an intensive Generative AI program with Bano Qabil, I now work across computer vision, machine learning, LLM applications and workflow automation, always with the goal of shipping something that works, not just a notebook that runs.

Zyron

Autonomous executive life & operating system

"Not an assistant — a digital extension of your authority."

Executives manage fragmented information across email, calendars, messaging, documents and finances. Traditional assistants are reactive. Zyron is a proactive AI Chief of Staff that reads the situation before you ask.

System architecture

A master orchestrator receives input from WhatsApp, web, email and biometrics, determines intent, builds an execution plan, delegates to specialised sub-agents and presents the final action for approval.

Inputs → Orchestrator → Sub-agents → Knowledge graph → Approval hub → Execution

Executive modules

Daily briefing

Analyses calendar, email and commitments each morning into one text or audio priority brief.

Contextual deep prep

Builds a dossier 15 minutes before each meeting from past emails, agendas and history.

Smart comm proxy

Interprets WhatsApp voice notes, checks availability and drafts replies for sign-off.

Friction guard

Tracks workload and biometrics to recommend recovery buffers and prevent burnout.

Closed-loop tracker

Turns spoken or written promises into tracked tasks with automated follow-ups.

Predictive schedule

Combines calendar and live traffic data to spot delays and pre-draft reschedules.

Memory & safety

A hybrid knowledge graph + vector memory keeps context across people, meetings and documents.

A human-in-the-loop architecture means the AI handles synthesis and preparation, but sensitive actions such as sending email, moving money or shifting meetings are never executed without explicit review in the approval hub.

Sentio

Multimodal emotional wellness companion

Helping people notice their emotional state and giving them simple ways to regulate it.

Many people feel stress, anxiety or exhaustion without recognising or naming it. This project explores how multimodal emotion recognition can power a supportive, interactive wellness system.

Multimodal understanding

Facial analysis

Real-time computer vision estimates states like happy, sad, angry or stressed.

Voice analysis

Speech characteristics are processed for vocal emotional cues.

Self-report

Users can override or add to the AI's read by describing how they feel.

Adaptive feedback loop

Emotion → Recommendation → User feedback → Alternative

The system suggests breathing exercises, journaling, short walks or AI-curated ASMR audio. If the user rejects an activity, the generative model produces alternatives, so the experience adapts to the person.

Stack & responsible AI

Built with Python, OpenCV, speech-processing APIs, NLP and generative LLMs.

Presented as an emotional-support tool, not a medical diagnostic system. Recommendations are general wellness suggestions.

Cloth Detection

Computer vision pipeline

Unstructured product photos are a real problem in e-commerce. I built a YOLO-based real-time detection framework that isolates and categorises clothing items in noisy images, with OpenCV handling noise reduction and confident bounding-box output.

Face Mask Detection

CNN image classification with MobileNetV2 transfer learning

Two architectures, one honest test set: 99.47% accuracy on images the model never saw in training.

The system decides whether a person is wearing a face mask. It accepts an uploaded photograph or a live webcam frame, locates the face and returns a colour-coded bounding box (green for mask, red for no mask) with a confidence score.

Approach

Kaggle dataset (7,553 images) → Resize 128×128 & normalise → Stratified 70/15/15 split → Train & compare → Webcam inference
Model A: custom CNN

A four-block convolutional network built from scratch as the baseline, so the gain from transfer learning could be measured rather than assumed.

Model B: MobileNetV2

An ImageNet-pretrained backbone with a small classification head, trained in two phases: frozen base first, then fine-tuned. This is the final model.

Training discipline

EarlyStopping with best-weight restoration, a separate untouched test set, and 128×128 inputs for roughly three times faster training at the same accuracy.

Stack

Python, TensorFlow/Keras 2.20, OpenCV, NumPy, Matplotlib, scikit-learn, trained on a Google Colab T4 GPU with the dataset pulled through kagglehub.

Zaynema

Content-based movie recommender with NLP sentiment analysis

Search a film, get ten you'll probably like, then write a review and let the model tell you how you felt about it.

Zaynema combines two machine-learning systems behind one web interface. The recommender builds a "feature soup" for each of the TMDB 5000 films from genres, keywords, top cast and director, vectorises it with TF-IDF and ranks by cosine similarity. The sentiment engine is trained on 50,000 IMDb reviews.

How it works

TMDB metadata → Feature soup → TF-IDF → Cosine similarity → Top-10 with live posters
Recommendation engine

Content-based filtering, so it works for any film without needing user history. Posters are fetched live from the TMDB API.

Sentiment analysis

Reviews are cleaned, lemmatised and vectorised; Naive Bayes and Logistic Regression were compared, and the better model classifies reviews as positive, neutral or negative with a confidence score.

Web app

Flask backend with search, recommend and analyse endpoints, trained models saved as pickles so nothing is retrained on startup, and a dark-themed vanilla JS frontend.

Team

Built with Israr Ul Haq and Husnain Rabbani. My work covered the recommender pipeline, the sentiment model and the Flask integration.

Zytech & ZyRobo

Software-house website with an AI quotation chatbot and admin dashboard

The server owns every price and every decision. The AI only owns the wording.

Zytech is a marketing site for a software house paired with ZyRobo, a chatbot that walks a client through a ten-step scoping conversation, prices the project from a database rate card and issues an itemised proposal with a project ID. An admin dashboard tracks every lead, including the ones who abandoned halfway.

Architecture decisions

Server-side pricing

One auditable function produces every quote from a 30-service catalogue and 25 extras, stored as integer cents. The model can never invent a price or confirm a deal.

AI as a rewriter

Gemini rephrases the question the server already chose, so the wizard reads like a conversation. Over-long or failed responses fall back silently to plain wording.

Resumable workflow

Answers are accepted one at a time and stored server-side, so a client can reload the page and continue. Declined quotes become leads instead of vanishing.

Admin dashboard

Scrypt authentication, hashed sessions, IP lockout, a lead pipeline with audit log, and CSV export with formula-injection protection.

Stack

Node.js, Express, SQLite, vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, Three.js for the 3D hero and an animated Draco-compressed robot, and Gemini for language.

Lead Qualification Pipeline

AI automation workflow in n8n

Every form submission on a business website is a lead of unknown quality. This workflow reads each one the moment it arrives, decides how promising it is and files it where the sales team will actually look.

Workflow

Form submission → Normalise fields → Gemini classification → Parse JSON → Route by category → Google Sheets
Structured AI output

Gemini is prompted to return strict JSON: lead category (Hot, Warm, Cold), customer intent, recommended service, a one-line summary, a suggested reply and a spam flag.

Routing

A switch node sends each lead to its own sheet, so hot leads never sit behind cold ones and spam never reaches a human.

Ready-to-send replies

The suggested reply is stored beside the lead, cutting first-response time to a copy and paste.

Credit Card Approval

Binary classification on the UCI credit-screening dataset

A complete supervised-learning pipeline that predicts whether a credit-card application will be approved. The emphasis was on doing the unglamorous parts properly: missing values, encoding, scaling, class balance and tuning.

Pipeline

Load & explore → Impute missing values → Label-encode → Standardise → SMOTE → Logistic regression → GridSearchCV
Data handling

Numeric gaps filled with the mean, categorical gaps with the mode, then label encoding and standard scaling across all 15 features.

Class balance

SMOTE oversampling is applied only if the minority class falls below 80% of the majority, keeping the model honest on imbalanced data.

Result

89.1% accuracy with macro precision, recall and F1 all at 0.89 on a stratified hold-out set, confirmed with a five-fold grid search over regularisation strength and penalty.

Lumina Sol

Generative AI brand and product visuals

Bioluminescence, bottled. A skincare brand that exists only because a prompt was written carefully enough.

Lumina Sol is a concept for a bioluminescent micro-algae serum. The project shows how a brand's visual identity, glowing blue tones, lab-inspired styling and a glossy high-end finish, can be produced with generative image models to campaign quality.

Deliverables

Lifestyle shot

A model applying the serum in a futuristic marble bathroom, with in-scene branding, product labelling and a city skyline, all specified in the prompt.

Product lineup

The full range of serum, mist, ampoules, cream and tube on a marble counter, with floating micro-algae cells as the brand motif.

Campaign copy

Social caption and hashtags written to match the visuals, so the set is ready to post as an Instagram launch or catalogue page.

Skill demonstrated

Precise prompt engineering: controlling composition, lighting, legible in-image text and consistent branding across multiple generations, which is the hard part of using image models commercially.
